text:
Maya T.: Quick thread for Mariner case + launch plan. Interview wrap this AM. Need approvals and lead routing before we push publish + webinar next week.

Maya T.: Draft headline: "How Mariner scaled inference 3x while lowering unit cost by ~30%" — feedback on phrasing?

Ethan B.: Nice. Suggest softening numbers a touch: "achieved up to 3x scaling and reduced unit cost by about 30%". Also add a short hero pull-quote.

Nora C.: Legal: get signed media release and the underlying cost export. Mariner restricts logo in paid channels but ok for organic. I'll need the exact dashboard CSV for the 30% claim.

Vik S.: Webinar plan: 18m demo, 12m customer story, 15m live Q&A. Can Mariner dedicates 10min for a short technical deep-dive? If yes, we'll reserve a slide slot. Slide deadline Thu 11am PT.

Maya T.: They can do 8-10min technical piece. I'll request a 2-line bio and headshot. Also adding: inbound leads should map to HubSpot campaign mariner-q3-launch. Want initial AE: Lina B.?

Ethan B.: Lina B. is good. For messaging, avoid words like "always" and include attribution: "based on Mariner + Redwood benchmarking (June 2025)".

Nora C.: Confirmed. Also redline the hero quote to remove absolutes. Once signed release is in Drive I can mark legal approved.

ops-bot: Reminder: publish job requires signed_media_release.pdf in the Drive folder.

Maya T.: Uploading draft doc and screenshots: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/MarinerDrafts. Sanitized traces only, no hostnames.

Vik S.: Starting deck template now. Will include a slide with sanitized trace + a pull-quote. Ping me when images are in Drive. :slide_with_curl:

Ethan B.: Social variants: product-first, cost-first, webinar-invite. Paid ads: logo off per Mariner. I'll drop copy in #marketing-drafts by tomorrow.

Maya T.: Checklist (please react when done):
- [ ] Signed media release uploaded
- [ ] Benchmark CSV linked
- [ ] Quote phrasing approved by product + legal
- [ ] Slides + bios submitted (Thu 11am PT)
- [ ] Webinar page live + registration tracking
- [ ] HubSpot campaign mariner-q3-launch + AE mapping

publish-bot: Draft announcement posted to #marketing-drafts for review.

Nora C.: I'll chase Mariner legal for the signature and validate the CSV once uploaded.

Maya T.: Thanks team 680. Target publish + webinar: next Wednesday. Will update here when legal signs off.
